title: Best Daily Trainer Running Shoes
excerpt: Daily trainers for most of your weekly miles: ASICS Novablast 6 and Gel-Cumulus 28, Hoka Skyward X 2, Nike Vomero Plus, Saucony Endorphin Azura and more.
body:
Best Daily Trainer Running Shoes

Updated November 2026. Prices are US list prices (MSRP) at the time of this update; retailers often sell for less.

A daily trainer is the shoe you wear for most of your weekly miles: easy runs, long runs and some steady efforts. These picks come from manufacturer specs and published reviews, which are linked at the end. Prices are US list prices (MSRP) at the time of this update.

The picks

ASICS Novablast 6: best all-rounder

The ASICS Novablast 6 lists at $155 and has an 8 mm drop. It's a well-cushioned, versatile trainer for easy runs and steadier efforts. It replaces the Novablast 5, which you may now find discounted.

ASICS Gel-Cumulus 28: simple and dependable

The ASICS Gel-Cumulus 28 lists at $145. It weighs 266 g in a UK size 9, according to The Run Testers, and has an 8 mm drop. It suits runners who mostly run easy and want a predictable, comfortable shoe.

Hoka Skyward X 2: maximum cushioning with a plate

The Hoka Skyward X 2 lists at $225 and has a 5 mm drop. It's a plated, high-stack "super trainer". Reviewers liked the ride but questioned the price, and it makes most sense if you'll also use it for faster long runs.

Nike Vomero Plus: max cushion from Nike

The Nike Vomero Plus lists at $180. It's a max-cushion Nike trainer for long and easy runs.

Saucony Endorphin Azura: light, plateless trainer

The Saucony Endorphin Azura lists at $150. It's a plateless daily trainer that uses Saucony's PWRRUN PB foam, and it suits runners who want a lighter shoe without a plate.

Hylo Athletics Impact 2: sustainability-focused option

The Hylo Athletics Impact 2 lists at $155 and went on sale in August 2026. Hylo says it's vegan and recyclable. One review noted some midfoot instability.

If you prefer ASICS

  • ASICS Gel-Nimbus 28 ($170): ASICS's most cushioned everyday trainer.
  • ASICS Gel-Kayano 33 ($170): the stability option, released in June 2026, with an 8 mm drop.
  • ASICS Superblast 3 ($210): a light, high-stack trainer that can also race.

How to choose

  • Mostly easy miles, and you want value: ASICS Novablast 6 or ASICS Gel-Cumulus 28.
  • Long runs, and you want maximum cushion: Nike Vomero Plus or Hoka Skyward X 2.
  • A lighter feel without a plate: Saucony Endorphin Azura.
  • Stability: ASICS Gel-Kayano 33.

Fit matters more than any list. Try shoes on later in the day, when your feet are largest, and leave about a thumb's width in front of your longest toe.
